publication_note: Retrieval and checksum verification are separate from reading the underlying publications. HITRAN and AER terms were read on retrieval: both permit research use with credit; neither dataset is redistributed by this repository. A hash mismatch means the upstream bytes changed (for example a new HITRAN edition) and must be reviewed, never silently accepted. AER's cross-section repository states no licence of its own; the HITRAN/PNNL and NCAR data it copies permit research use with credit, and none of it is redistributed here.
